candidate.answerReason: The graph gives 1 mile in 5 minutes. Thirty minutes contains six such intervals, so the distance is 6 miles.

methods.label: Equal five-minute intervals
methods.explanation:
The graph shows that Suzanna rides \(1\) mile in \(5\) minutes. Since her speed stays constant, she travels another mile during every five-minute interval.

Half an hour is \(30\) minutes, which contains
\[
30\div 5=6
\]
five-minute intervals. Therefore, she rides \(6\times 1=6\) miles, choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
methods.levelReason: Reading a plotted point and using equal time intervals requires only elementary graph interpretation, proportional reasoning, and arithmetic.
